title: [Request] 新增qwen3 coder模型
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

阿里云百炼新上架了商业版`qwen3-coder-plus`和开源版`qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct`，需要新增

### 🧐 解决方案

新增`qwen3-coder-plus`和`qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct`

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

linked_prs.title: 🐛 fix: moonshot assistant messages must not be empty
linked_prs.body:
#### 💻 变更类型 | Change Type

<!-- For change type, change [ ] to [x]. -->

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

- close #8418
- close #8554

解决下述错误：
```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "Invalid request: the message at position 1 with role 'assistant' must not be empty"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.moonshot.cn/v1",
  "provider": "moonshot"
}
```

另去除模型内置搜索，因 lobechat 不支持。

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

<!-- Add any other context about the Pull Request here. -->

## Summary by Sourcery

Filter out empty assistant messages to prevent invalid requests and disable browser requests for Moonshot provider to avoid CORS errors

Bug Fixes:
- Remove assistant messages with empty content before sending payload to Moonshot API

Enhancements:
- Add disableBrowserRequest setting to Moonshot model provider configuration to work around CORS issues

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue requests the addition of new LLM models (`qwen3-coder-plus` and `qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct`), which falls under the "Unsupported models" sub-category of "Incompatibility with LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.
